name: Trivago RecSys Challenge 2019 dataset
what_it_holds: Official Trivago clickstream dataset: ~910k user sessions / ~15M interactions (clicks, filters, sort actions, impressions with price) over European hotel search sessions, released for the ACM RecSys 2019 Challenge. GitHub repo wydzik/trivago-recsyschallenge-2019 only contains data-splitting notebooks (dask_data_split.ipynb, data_split.ipynb, functions.py) that assume the user already has the official CSVs from the challenge site/Kaggle mirror — no data files are committed to the repo itself.
why_useful: A large real clickstream dataset with hotel prices and session-level search behavior across European markets in 2019; could inform methodology for search-intent-to-booking conversion or price-elasticity structure relevant to gap 9 (Expedia/Booking.com adjacent supply) and gap 2 (realized pricing proxies), but it is not committed to GitHub and is now a stale (2019) one-time competition snapshot rather than an ongoing feed.
license: none stated on wydzik repo; official dataset carries RecSys Challenge academic-use terms
time_coverage: 2019 (roughly Nov 2018-Apr 2019 session window per public challenge description)
size_hint: ~15M interaction rows / ~910k sessions (official); GitHub repo itself <1MB of scripts
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers
why_all: A large real clickstream dataset with hotel prices and session-level search behavior across European markets in 2019; could inform methodology for search-intent-to-booking conversion or price-elasticity structure relevant to gap 9 (Expedia/Booking.com adjacent supply) and gap 2 (realized pricing proxies), but it is not committed to GitHub and is now a stale (2019) one-time competition snapshot rather than an ongoing feed.

name: trivago-scraper (Oxylabs)
what_it_holds: Commercial scraper wrapper (Oxylabs) for pulling live Trivago hotel search-result pages: location, price, ratings, amenities, guest reviews, via Oxylabs' paid scraping API. Code-examples folder with sample requests in several languages and a JSON response schema; no data files committed. 33 stars, 1 fork, 13 commits, no license file visible.
why_useful: Illustrates a currently working method to pull live trivago.com hotel price comparisons across many booking sites, which could proxy short-term hotel-rate movements (gap 8/9) if a human decided to run it; commercial/proxy-dependent and off the sanctioned-source list, so flagged as method only.
themes: Expedia and Hotels.com datasets (Expedia hotel recommendation Kaggle, personalized ranking ICDM 2013, Expedia scrapers), Trivago RecSys 2019, Kayak/Skyscanner scrapers
why_all: Illustrates a currently working method to pull live trivago.com hotel price comparisons across many booking sites, which could proxy short-term hotel-rate movements (gap 8/9) if a human decided to run it; commercial/proxy-dependent and off the sanctioned-source list, so flagged as method only.

A live-price acquisition method for hotel ADR/occupancy proxies (gap #2) via a metasearch aggregator that indexes many OTAs including Airbnb-adjacent short-term-rental listings on some markets -- flagged as method only; requires a paid API key so not runnable under project rules without a human decision, and touches a live commercial site (ToS question).

name: rn5l/rsc19
what_it_holds: Another RecSys Challenge 2019 (trivago) competitor submission: preprocessing scripts, session-log transformation, latent-factor generation, LightGBM training. Requires user to extract a provided data zip into _data/raw manually -- no data committed, no license file visible.
why_useful: Second independent implementation of the trivago session-log pipeline; marginal beyond logicai-io's repo but confirms multiple independent codebases exist for the same dataset, increasing confidence the underlying data is recoverable if a human clears the ToS question.

name: rosetta-ai/rosetta_recsys2019
what_it_holds: 4th-place solution to RecSys Challenge 2019 by Team RosettaAI. Code and docs only (Neural Net / LightGBM / XGBoost models); README instructs placing unzipped official challenge data into an input/ directory -- no data files committed. Apache-2.0, 58 stars, 16 forks, 41 commits.
why_useful: Third independent trivago-challenge codebase; adds little beyond logicai-io but is a clean, well-documented modeling reference if the team ever gets the underlying session logs.
